📝 Walkthrough

Walkthrough

This PR adds an AI gateway feature: new core contracts and OpenWebUI/OIDC adapters, persisted AI configuration, an AI usecase (state/selectors/thunks), bootstrap and launcher wiring to provision region and custom AI providers, an Account "AI" tab with model selection and custom-provider management, and localized translations. Also refactors helm-values object resolution order and array-item context handling.

Changes

AI Gateway Integration

Layer / File(s) Summary
Developer guide and env config
web/CLAUDE.md, web/.env, web/src/env.ts, web/src/vite-env.d.ts, web/src/ui/App/App.tsx, api		 Adds repository guidance docs, defines and parses ENABLED_AI, wires it into bootstrap, and bumps the api submodule.
Contracts and adapters
web/src/core/ports/Ai.ts, .../OnyxiaApi/DeploymentRegion.ts, .../onyxiaApi/ApiTypes.ts, .../onyxiaApi/onyxiaApi.ts, .../tools/oidcTokenExchange.ts, .../tools/fetchAiModels.ts, .../adapters/ai/*, .../adapters/oidc/oidc.ts		 Defines Ai/GetTokenResult types, region ai config, token exchange and model fetch helpers, the OpenWebUI adapter with getToken/listModels, and disableDPoP OIDC support.
AI persisted state and thunks
.../usecases/ai/*, .../usecases/userConfigs.ts, .../usecases/index.ts		 Adds persisted AI config parsing/serialization, State model and reducers, selectors, and thunks/protectedThunks for provider lifecycle, token refresh, and model loading.
Bootstrap and launcher wiring
web/src/core/bootstrap.ts, .../usecases/launcher/thunks.ts, .../ports/OnyxiaApi/XOnyxia.ts		 Wires region AI adapters at bootstrap, exposes context.ai, awaits AI initialization in the launcher, and attaches the AI snapshot to XOnyxiaContext.
Helm value overwrite resolution
.../launcher/decoupledLogic/computeHelmValues.ts, .../computeRootForm/computeRootFormFieldGroup.ts, associated tests		 Reorders object-schema resolution after x-onyxia overwrite handling and scopes array-item context via a Proxy, with new test coverage.
Account AI tab UI components
.../account/accountTabIds.ts, .../account/Page.tsx, .../account/AccountAiTab/*, web/src/ui/i18n/types.ts		 Registers the "ai" tab and implements AccountAiTab, CustomProviderFormDialog, ModelsSection, and ProviderValueField components.
AI gateway translations
web/src/ui/i18n/resources/*.tsx		 Adds Account.ai labels and AccountAiGatewayTab translation blocks across all locales.

web/src/core/usecases/ai/thunks.ts (1)

145-150: 🏗️ Heavy lift

testCustomProvider returns a Promise<string[]> which violates the reactive thunk pattern.

Per the coding guidelines for web/src/core/**/*.ts: "Use observable state with thunks (reactive pattern) rather than promise-based returns; dispatch actions and read state instead of returning values from thunks."

The test result (model list or error) should be stored in state via new actions (e.g., providerTestStarted, providerTestSucceeded({ models }), providerTestFailed) and exposed via a selector, with the UI subscribing to state instead of awaiting the thunk.

- Line 10: The apiBase string composition concatenates webUiUrl directly with

forward slash, potentially breaking strict gateways or proxies. Normalize the
webUiUrl by removing any trailing slash before composing the apiBase string. Use
a method to strip the trailing slash from webUiUrl (such as using replace or
trimEnd with proper regex/string manipulation) so that the final apiBase always
has exactly one slash between the base URL and the `/api` path.

optional by adding .optional() to the z.string() for name, or use

the optional approach, update the mapping logic to handle cases where name may
be undefined. If using the default approach, ensure the default value is applied
appropriately in the schema definition.

undefined (enforcing model selection before launch), or modify the
activeProvider selector itself to return undefined instead of a valid context
object when provider.selection.modelId is not set, ensuring downstream code
receives undefined rather than a context with an empty model string.

In `@web/src/core/adapters/onyxiaApi/onyxiaApi.ts`:
- Around line 448-450: The region AI provider mapping currently uses
aiConfigs_api.map with a fallback id of onyxia-${i}, which is order-dependent
and can change when the API reorders providers. Update the fallback in the
onyxiaApi adapter to derive from stable provider fields already available in
each aiConfig_api entry (for example id, URL, or another immutable provider
attribute) instead of the loop index, so persisted activeProviderId values
continue to point to the same gateway.

In `@web/src/core/usecases/ai/selectors.ts`:
- Around line 26-29: The provider activation flag in select AI selectors
currently only checks provider.models.stateDescription, which incorrectly allows
loaded providers with no availableModels to be activatable. Update the
canBeActivated logic in selectors.ts to also require a non-empty models list
(for example by checking provider.models.availableModels length) so zero-model
providers are not exposed as launchable, while keeping the existing
provider.models and selectedModelId mapping intact.

In `@web/src/core/usecases/ai/state.ts`:
- Around line 107-121: modelsLoaded in state.ts only initializes selectedModelId
when it is undefined, so a refresh can leave provider.selectedModelId pointing
to a model no longer present in provider.models.availableModels. Update the
modelsLoaded handler to validate the current selection against payload.models
and clear or replace it when it is stale, while still preserving the existing
default-to-first-model behavior for providers with no valid selection.

AccountAiGatewayTab even when AI is unavailable, because the switch case for
"ai" has no availability check. Update the route/render logic in the Page
component to gate the "ai" case with ai.isAvailable() (the same guard used to
hide the navigation tab), and fall back to the existing not-available handling
when AI is disabled.

Inline comments:
In `@web/src/core/bootstrap.ts`:
- Line 321: The OIDC cache key in bootstrap.ts is built with a raw NUL
separator, which can break text tooling and editor handling. Update the key
generation in the oidcKey assignment to use a safe serialized delimiter instead,
such as JSON.stringify over issuerUri and clientId, and ensure any lookup code
that relies on this key uses the same serialization in the related OIDC
bootstrap flow.
- Around line 301-308: `bootstrapCore` should not crash when
`onyxiaApi.getAvailableRegionsAndOidcParams()` returns undefined in this branch;
replace the `assert(oidcParams !== undefined)` in the `Promise.all` result
handling with a guard that skips the region-backed OIDC/Ai adapter setup when no
global OIDC config exists. Use the existing `createAi`, `createOidc`, and
`mergeOidcParams` flow to continue custom-provider initialization only when
`oidcParams` is present, and keep the fallback behavior consistent with the
earlier undefined handling in `bootstrapCore`.

In `@web/src/core/usecases/ai/selectors.ts`:
- Around line 76-94: The provider selector is leaking secrets by keeping apiKey
on every ready provider view, which then gets serialized into XOnyxiaContext by
the launch flow. Update the selector in selectors.ts so providerViews entries
for inactive providers do not include apiKey, and keep the secret only on the
activeProvider returned by the selector. Make sure to preserve the existing
provider shaping in toProviderView while redacting the secret field from the
array used for providers.
